prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult South African woman — the personification of Cape Town — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Cape Town as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Cape Town with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a sunny snow slope, anti-gravity snowboards hovering over the powder, pines and a glowing lift line beyond
Season: autumn — April and May, the south-easter season over, mild sunny days and the odd thunderstorm before the winter fronts arrive.
Time of day: evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Hair: her hair tucked neatly behind both ears — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: a tight cropped knit top baring the waist and a snug bodycon mini skirt, with high heels — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with sleeves pushed up to the elbows, a high-waisted line and a slim leather belt at the waist, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing balanced on her board, feet set apart across it, knees softly bent, her silhouette steady.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both arms are held out wide for balance.
LEGS: knees softly bent, feet planted apart across the board.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slim chrome signal baton unfurling a banner of glowing light that flashes bright warning colours — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
acceptance: user selected world candidate 1 and authorized commit and ordinary main update; no exposure-based regeneration

generation.note: Original PNG retained locally; only WebP uploaded. One generation per slot, no regeneration.
